description: This file contains the definition of the OutboundEmailAccountsController class, which manages the display and saving of outbound email account configurations within the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods to control access, validate, and process email account data.

classes.name: OutboundEmailAccountsController
classes.description: Controller class handling outbound email account views and save actions, with access control and validation logic.

methods.name: action_EditView
methods.description: Handles display logic for editing an outbound email account, including access checks and view selection based on account type.

methods.name: action_save
methods.description: Processes the saving of outbound email account data, including validation, access control, and error handling.
